scenes.headline: The Forest Remembers Its Giant
scenes.angle: very low worm's-eye looking up the trunk of a giant chestnut
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean fine black ink line and flat colour, slightly worn pen contours, one cel-shadow tone per surface, risograph print feel with paper grain. Very low worm's-eye view from the forest floor looking straight up a colossal American chestnut trunk with deep bark grooves drawn in thin hatched lines, branches spreading into a canopy of serrated long leaves and spiky burrs. Two small hikers in outline at the base, hands correct with five fingers, natural knuckles, full-length thumbs, one resting a palm on the bark, tiny beside the giant. Short hatched blades of grass and fallen leaves at the bottom. Hard-edged pools of light and shadow shapes through the canopy. scenes.headline: A Century After the Blight
scenes.angle: one-point perspective down a long forest corridor of trees
scenes.prompt: Follows the attached style guide image (style only, not its subjects). Contemporary editorial illustration in clean fine black ink line and flat colour, slightly worn contours, one cel-shadow tone per surface, stepped-band glows, risograph print feel with paper grain. Strong one-point perspective looking down a straight Appalachian forest trail, a row of tall trunks on each side converging at a vanishing point of stepped yellow light. On the left the trunks are pale, dead, blighted grey chestnut snags with peeling bark and orange-less canker marks drawn in hatching; on the right they are young living chestnuts with leaves.
